name: ai.kineticad.get/cnc-parts
title: KinetiCAD CNC Parts
description: Check, price and order CNC machined parts from your agent's CadQuery code or STEP file.

tools.name: build_part
tools.description: Build one part from CadQuery code in KinetiCAD's CAD kernel and check that it is a solid a shop can machine. Returns a part_id, the measured size and volume, every round hole and round outside surface with its diameter and direction, warnings (for example a cut that removed nothing), a picture, and a link where the user can rotate the part in 3D. The code runs in a sandbox with only `cadquery` (as `cq`) and `math`. Leave the finished solid in a variable named `result`, or pass it to `show_object()`. Units are millimeters. The part must be ONE closed solid, at most 1000 mm long. A cavity sealed inside the material is rejected, because no cutter can reach it. The code can be up to 20000 characters long. Optional: define PARAMS (a list of {name, label, unit, value, min, max}) and a function build(p) that returns the solid. The user can then change those dimensions on the part's page. If the build fails, the error says what is wrong and on which line: fix the code and call again. Parts are kept for 30 days.

cadquery.description: CadQuery (Python) code for one part, in millimeters.

name.description: Short name of the part, for example: Motor bracket.

about.description: One sentence on what the part is for. The KinetiCAD team sees it with an order request.

tools.name: view_part
tools.description: Get a picture of a part from one side, with its measured size and features. Use it to check that the part is what the user asked for before you price or order it.

part_id.description: The part_id that build_part (or the HTTP upload of a STEP file) returned.

view.description: The side to look from. iso looks down from the front right; under shows the underside.

tools.name: price_part
tools.description: Get the price to CNC machine a part in the US. KinetiCAD's engine plans how the part is machined (the machine, the setups, the tools and the cycle time), and the price is the setup time and the machine time at a US shop rate, plus the material. Returns the unit price for the quantity, the cost lines, the plan and the delivery date. Planning a new part takes from about 10 seconds to a few minutes: if status is planning, call again after retry_after_seconds. Prices are in US dollars.

part_id.description: The part_id that build_part (or the HTTP upload of a STEP file) returned.

material.description: What the part is machined from.

tools.name: request_order
tools.description: Send an order request for a part to KinetiCAD. Call this only after the user has seen the price and said yes, and has given a shipping address and an email address. It sends those details to KinetiCAD. No payment is taken: Bera Demirhan at KinetiCAD emails the user within 1 business day with the confirmed price and delivery date, and the user pays only after agreeing. Ships within the US only.

part_id.description: The part_id that build_part (or the HTTP upload of a STEP file) returned.

material.description: What the part is machined from.

email.description: Where KinetiCAD sends the confirmed price and delivery date.

state.description: US state, two letters, for example CA.

notes.description: Anything the shop should know: threads, fits, finish, a date the parts are needed by.
